metaTitle: How to Choose a Winter Sleeping Bag
description: Choose a winter sleeping bag by Comfort rating, insulation, shape and features, and pair it with the right pad and habits for cold nights.
directAnswer: Take the coldest expected low, subtract 10 degrees, and buy a bag whose Comfort rating matches. Choose a snug mummy with a hood and draft collar, pick down or synthetic by moisture risk, and use an R-5 pad.
